about.en: COLLECT is the token of Fanable and the Collect Foundation, a marketplace for physical collectibles such as graded trading cards, comics and figurines that are vaulted and traded as on-chain ownership records and can be redeemed for the physical item. COLLECT is a BNB Smart Chain BEP-20 token at 0x4b3d30992f003c8167699735f5ab2831b2a087d3.
